recognize_zh: 高倍下大量淡染、細空泡狀的泡沫組織球，核小而圓、無明顯異型，間夾纖細的膠原纖維；典型的黃色瘤樣（xanthomatous）組織球浸潤，符合 Erdheim-Chester 病。
features: Sheets of large histiocytes with abundant pale, finely vacuolated foamy cytoplasm
Small, round to oval, hyperchromatic, bland nuclei
Indistinct cell borders with delicate intervening collagen fibers
Scattered spindle fibroblasts and small vessels
No multinucleated giant cells, atypia, or mitoses in this field
describe_en: High-power view shows a diffuse infiltrate of histiocytes with abundant pale, finely vacuolated foamy cytoplasm and small bland round to oval nuclei, separated by delicate collagen fibers with scattered fibroblasts and small vessels. No significant nuclear atypia, mitotic figures, emperipolesis, or eosinophils are seen. Findings are consistent with a xanthomatous histiocytic infiltrate, compatible with Erdheim-Chester disease in the appropriate immunophenotypic, radiologic, and molecular context.

ddx.vs: Xanthomas are morphologically similar but lack systemic involvement and MAPK pathway mutations and are linked to lipid disorders.
LCH cells have eosinophilic non-foamy cytoplasm with grooved nuclei and CD1a/Langerin positivity.

ddx.dx: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma (in retroperitoneal lesions)
ddx.vs: RCC cells have sharp cell borders, glycogen-rich clear cytoplasm, and keratin/PAX8 positivity rather than CD68/CD163.

ddx.dx: Atypical mycobacterial or Whipple infection with foamy macrophages
ddx.vs: Infection-associated foamy macrophages contain organisms demonstrable by AFB or PAS-D stains.
